description: Lists the media items, sequences and bins in the project, a page at a time (200 by default) so a big show project does not flood the reply. Filter by name, type or bin; nextOffset gets the next page.

binPath.description: Only items inside this bin, e.g. "Renders/SH010"

includeBins.description: Whether to include bin information in the results

includeMetadata.description: Whether to include detailed metadata for each item

nameContains.description: Only items whose name contains this (case-insensitive)

offset.description: Start of the page; use nextOffset from the previous reply

name: list_project_items
